test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Aug 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A forest area that belongs to private individuals and communities is classified as ________ .
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unclassed forest**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unclassed forests **are more forests and wastes that are owned by the government, as well as by private people and groups.
 
• Other than reserved and protected woods, all other forests and **wastelands** are considered unclassified forests.
 
• **Gujarat** and India's northeastern states have the majority of their forests classed as unclassified.
 
• In certain regions of India,** religious belief** has led to the preservation of particular species of trees.
 
• Communities conserve certain areas of forests or entire forests because they believe these are the homes of** gods and goddesses**.
 
• **Sacred groves** are the name given to these types of protected forest habitats.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• India has recognised about one-third of its forests as being under **protection**. Bihar, Haryana, Punjab, Himachal Pradesh, Orissa, and Rajasthan all have a majority of their woods that are protected.
 
• The government has designated **conserved forests** on more than half of the entire forestland. When it comes to the preservation of forest and wildlife resources, reserved forests are thought to be the most valuable.
 
• **Permanent** **forest** estates maintained for the aim of producing timber and other forest products as well as for protective purposes are another name for reserved and protected forests.
